verdict.rationale: Preventing training on user data is a fair privacy question for a self-hosted AI assistant, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-use guarantee. Self-hosting, local Markdown memory and choice among LLM providers are adjacent features, not this capability. One user running local models in their own VM is a user-side workaround, not a documented product capability.
